items.name: Certificate of Organization (Pennsylvania LLC)
items.quote: Online Filing Business Filing Services allows you to submit your filings electronically, but your application still requires human review.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
items.feeQuote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Pennsylvania tax registration
items.quote: New customers can register for various taxes without logging in to myPATH using the Pennsylvania Online Business Tax Registration.

items.name: Philadelphia food safety certificate
items.quote: You can apply and pay for your City of Philadelphia food safety certificate online, in person, or by mail.

items.name: Philadelphia tax account (BIRT and wage tax)
items.agency: City of Philadelphia Department of Revenue
items.quote: You also need a PHTIN to get a Commercial Activity License (CAL) , which is required to do any business in Philadelphia.

items.name: Commercial Activity License
items.agency: City of Philadelphia, Department of Licenses and Inspections
items.quote: You should always make sure you have a Commercial Activity License before applying for other business licenses.

items.name: Food business plan review
items.quote: Anyone opening a stationary food business must submit a plan review for approval.

items.name: Building permit for the build-out
items.agency: City of Philadelphia, Department of Licenses and Inspections
items.quote: Obtain permits for limited demolition and commercial alterations without submitting plans by meeting the Conditions and Design Limitations below.

items.name: Food preparation and serving license
items.agency: City of Philadelphia, Department of Licenses and Inspections
items.quote: You can apply for this license online using eCLIPSE or in person at the Permit and License Center.
